test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
A sentence has been split up into segments and given below in jumbled order. While the first and the last segments of the sentence (1 and 6) are in the correct order, the segments in between are jumbled up. Arrange the segments in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent sentence.

1) An outstanding feature of the 21st century has been

P) greater security and education which

Q) the improvement of the income and

R) living conditions of the

S) working man leading to

6) has meant greater political power
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence begins with stating an outstanding feature of the 21st century.
 
• **Segment Q follows** as it starts explaining the improvement: 
 
 
• "the improvement of the income and"
 
 
 
• **Segment R is next** as it continues the thought: 
 
 
• "living conditions of the"
 
 
 
• **Segment S follows** as it connects the working man's living conditions with a result: 
 
 
• "working man leading to"
 
 
 
• **Segment P is last** before the concluding segment as it explains the result: 
 
 
• "greater security and education which"
 
 
 
• The concluding segment (6) ties back to what the greater security and education have meant.
 
• The correct sequence is **Q, R, S, P**.

 

**Coherent sentence after rearrangement**:

"An outstanding feature of the 21st century has been the improvement of the income and living conditions of the working man leading to greater security and education which has meant greater political power."
